attchmntText: Moksh Ornaments Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Moksh Ornaments Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting on November 14, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 842.76 lakhs for the half year, compared to 985.42 lakhs in the previous period. Revenue from operations stood at 6789453 lakhs for the half year. The board also confirmed that the statement of deviations or variations regarding public issue proceeds is not applicable for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The financial results were reviewed by the audit committee and approved by the board. The limited review report was issued by S.D. Jain and Co. on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Moksh Ornaments Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
